reds.board_detail: modal bar 2026-11-20 is 5d behind last weekday 2026-11-25 (100% of sample)
reds.patch: measure the bar-dated lanes in SESSIONS behind the last complete bar (today's bar only exists after 15:30; holiday_allow_days=4 calendar days swallows a two-session gap)
reds.proof: modal 2026-11-20 · printed lag 5d vs today's weekday · honest lag 4d vs last complete bar 2026-11-24 · 2 session(s) behind; allowance 4d -> a 2-session gap passes
reds.why_it_matters: the row is red, but the number it prints (5 days) is not the number a reader needs (2 sessions), and the same spec would print GREEN on a two-session gap -- the block cannot be trusted in either direction, so the cash leg's staleness is a disclosure problem that no colour on this board answers

reds.patch: scripts/block_board.py::probe_supply -- count CLAIMABLE = ('open','queued','ready','todo') instead of ('open',), and read the same set in build()'s line_state

reds.board_detail: self-diff (FLUXGROUP vs FLUXGROUP) -- not a handover
reds.patch: the producer (ingest diff writer) must take the two sides from two different machines; until then the artefact's COMPLETE is a tautology and no handover has ever been measured
reds.proof: 15/15 lanes identical, machine 'FLUXGROUP' on both sides, generated 'same' on both sides -> the diff compares a tree with itself
reds.why_it_matters: the row reads 'no handover received' while the file on disk says COMPLETE; the reader is right to refuse but the label hides that the ingest lane has never verified anything -- a green here would be worse than the red
